decision.title: Hail to the Thief (Live Recordings 2003-2009)
tracklist: Where I End and You Begin.

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hail_to_the_Thief_(Live_Recordings_2003%E2%80%932009), https://www.discogs.com/release/34809743-Radiohead-Hail-To-The-Thief-Live-Recordings-2003-2009. Official live album (digital Aug 13, 2025; CD/vinyl Oct 31, 2025, XL Recordings). Performances from London, Amsterdam, Buenos Aires and Dublin 2003-2009. Omits 'Backdrifts' and 'A Punchup at a Wedding' from the studio album.
